name: Contact Form 7
storage_notes: Forms are CPT wpcf7_contact_form. The authoritative form content and settings are post meta _form (string), _mail (array), _mail_2 (array), _messages (array), _additional_settings (string), plus _locale and _hash. post_content stores a flattened, human-readable copy of the properties but is not read back as the source of truth. A single global option wpcf7 is an array of integration/version settings. Config-validator results are cached in _config_validation post meta.

settings.summary: Single global option array holding plugin version, bulk-validation state and integration credentials/options. Version is written on load; integration keys appear only after configuration.

meta.summary: Raw form template containing CF7 form tags such as [text* your-name].
meta.format_notes: Save through WPCF7_ContactForm::save() or wpcf7_save_contact_form(). Sanitized with wpcf7_kses() for users lacking unfiltered_html (includes/contact-form-functions.php:369).

Keys: active (bool), subject, sender, recipient, body, additional_headers, attachments, use_html (bool), exclude_blank (bool); see includes/contact-form-functions.php:388. Saving through wpcf7_save_contact_form() forces active=true.
Same keys as _mail; active defaults false and must be true to send. wpcf7_sanitize_mail() normalizes line endings of additional_headers.

Core keys: mail_sent_ok, mail_sent_ng, validation_error, spam, accept_terms, invalid_required, invalid_too_long, invalid_too_short (includes/contact-form-template.php:164). Values are trimmed strings.
Recognized keys include demo_mode, skip_mail, subscribers_only, do_not_store, acceptance_as_validation, doi and flamingo_* (is_true/pref calls in includes and modules). Not a JSON structure.

meta.summary: Form locale used for messages and mail templates.
meta.format_notes: Validated by wpcf7_is_valid_locale(); written on save (includes/contact-form.php:1290).

meta.summary: Unique random hash used in shortcode/hash lookups.
meta.format_notes: Generated once with add_post_meta(..., true) (includes/contact-form.php:1294). Never overwrite.
Written by WPCF7_ConfigValidator::save() (includes/config-validator/validator.php:348); regenerate by validating, do not hand-edit.

meta.summary: Legacy pre-3.0 form unit ID used by the old shortcode format.

actions.name: list_forms
actions.summary: List contact forms using WP_Query defaults (post_status any, all forms).

params.args: WP_Query args; post_type forced to wpcf7_contact_form

actions.name: get_form
actions.summary: Load one form object with decoded properties.

actions.name: save_form
actions.summary: Create or update a form; sanitizes the supplied properties and calls save() when context is 'save'.

params.data: id, title, locale, form, mail, mail_2, messages, additional_settings

actions.name: delete_form
actions.summary: Permanently delete the form post and all its meta.

actions.name: validate_form
actions.summary: Run configuration validation and cache errors in _config_validation.

objects.storage: CPT wpcf7_contact_form; properties in _form/_mail/_mail_2/_messages/_additional_settings post meta; duplicate flattened copy in post_content
objects.summary: A contact form and its mail, message and additional settings.
objects.crud_notes: List with WPCF7_ContactForm::find(); read with wpcf7_contact_form($id)/get_properties(); create with wpcf7_save_contact_form(['id'=>-1,...]) or REST POST with context=save; update with id + properties; delete permanently via $form->delete(). Do not write post_content/_form directly unless replicating save() meta writes and hash generation.

detection.active_check: defined('WPCF7_VERSION') or class_exists('WPCF7_ContactForm'); plugin basename WPCF7_PLUGIN_BASENAME (contact-form-7/wp-contact-form-7.php)

gotchas: REST create/update require context=save. The callbacks pass the request's context directly to wpcf7_save_contact_form(); when it is absent/null the function performs a dry run and does not save (includes/rest-api.php:207, includes/contact-form-functions.php:356).

REST GET responses turn properties.form into an object {content, fields} and additional_settings into {content, settings}; write APIs expect the raw form string and newline settings string (includes/rest-api.php:463).
post_content is only a flattened copy of the properties (includes/contact-form.php:1265); changing it directly does not update the live form.
_hash is generated once by add_post_meta with unique=true; preserve it.
Form capabilities map as follows: read/edit/delete_contact_form(s) -> edit_posts for read and publish_pages for write/delete (includes/capabilities.php:9, wp-contact-form-7.php:49,53).
Deletion is permanent: wp_delete_post($id, true) (includes/contact-form.php:1338), with no trash step.
Configuration validation reports config_errors but does not block saving; invalid mail tags/from headers can persist.
Contact Form 7 core does not store submissions or entries; install Flamingo (separate plugin) or another integration for storage.
mail.active is forced true when saved through wpcf7_save_contact_form(); mail_2.active defaults false, and additional_headers is normalized line by line.
Contact Form 7 6.2.4.1 requires WordPress 7.1 and PHP 8.3 (readme.txt); guard feature availability by version.
